title: Habitica Daily Completion Rate
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:habit habit_name=* daily_completed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(daily_completed="yes",1,0))) as matched by habit_name
| eval a_completed_daily_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_completed_daily_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Habitica dailies that end with a completed daily by habit.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which habit are helping or hurting Habitica dailies.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a completed daily` on `lifeos:habit` events and summarize the hit rate by `habit_name`.
visualization: Table of habit with percentage of Habitica dailies ending with a completed daily.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how often a completed daily happens for each habit so you can see where Habitica dailies go smoothly or get stuck.
